event_text: m_c approaches c_n's border, asking to join the Clan where r_c lives. They hope their kits can grow up knowing both of their parents.
After considering m_c's request, lead_name agrees and welcomes them to c_n, hoping r_c's kits will be as loyal as {PRONOUN/r_c/object}.

Despite m_c's conviction to join, lead_name is not convinced that c_n needs more mouths to feed. m_c is turned away, shocked and reeling, and there is nothing that r_c can do to change lead_name's mind.
